description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Dr. Mog] to self. Grants [Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party] based on if entry damage was Fire/Ice/Lightning/Soil/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Dr. Mog
description.text: Black Magic/Summoning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic/Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted
